review.selectedRoute: Apply existing closed-residue and actual divisor pullback/pushforward, degree and norm theorems directly to the already proved actual Gamma1 fields and finite Hecke maps. No new curve or Picard foundations; no extraneous generalization.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: Every place of the actual Gamma1 and Hecke fields over algebraically closed constants has the same residue field as the constants. The literal beta pullback followed by alpha pushforward preserves degree zero and principal divisors. It therefore defines the actual Gamma1 Hecke endomorphism of degree-zero divisor classes, with exact representative evaluation. Finite-map, residue-degree, degree-preservation and principal-divisor-preservation inputs are derived.
